summary: Huckleberry.ai (formerly Domo) filed an 8-K reporting completion of the sale of substantially all assets and employees to Progress Software under the July 22, 2026 Asset Purchase Agreement, excluding net operating loss carryforwards. The company renamed itself Huckleberry.ai, terminated its Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement (paid in full, liens released), and will trade on Nasdaq under HUCK from September 24, 2026. No price, premium, or advisor named. Watch for NOL-retention structure and any residual shell value.
